cases.title: caps large phone layouts to the stream frame budget
cases.reason: Large phone frame dimensions respect stream ceilings.

cases.title: waits for a measured browser pane before subscribing
cases.reason: Absent/zero layout delays subscription.

rationale: Remove copied budget/envelope formulas and 200,000-sample JSON-number sweep; preserve actual shell serialization, density bounds, base64 padding and hot-path work guards.

cases.title: is needed: the native request overflows the frame cap on a phone
cases.reason: Native request genuinely exceeds bridge budget for reference phone; establishes need for web adjustment.

cases.title: keeps the worst case frame inside one bridge message
cases.reason: Web phone density yields bytes within declared wire cap.

cases.title: asks for the scale the cap and the worst case together allow
cases.reason: replace repeated sqrt formula with next-hundredth overflow assertion; catches under-requesting density without copying implementation.

cases.title: leaves web mode byte-identical to the native request
cases.reason: Web desktop/default requests agree with actual native builder.

cases.title: never asks for more density than native, on a viewport the budget does not bind
cases.reason: Nonbinding small viewport retains native density.

cases.title: stops at one device pixel per CSS pixel on a viewport no scale would fit
cases.reason: Impossible viewport clamps to one pixel per CSS pixel.

cases.title: answers the native factor when there is no layout to budget against
cases.reason: Absent/zero layout preserves native fallback without subscription.

cases.title: spends the whole cap that the envelope leaves
cases.reason: reimplements exact area-floor formula; real shell posted-frame cap and tightness tests independently cover result.

cases.title: counts base64 padding, which the ratio does not for every image size
cases.reason: retain exact 3001-byte -> 4004-char padding example; remove assertions about Math arithmetic/ratio supplied by the test.

cases.title: leaves a frame of exactly the budgeted area inside the cap, padding included
cases.reason: copied frame-size arithmetic duplicates real shell cap assertion.

cases.title: measures the envelope rather than naming a number, and leaves it room to grow
cases.reason: arbitrary envelope 200-byte/1% bounds are weaker than retained real serialization/tightness checks.

cases.title: is at least what a real frame event costs at its widest
cases.reason: hand-built widest envelope duplicates production skeleton; independent real host serializer check remains.

cases.title: is a bound on every finite double, not on the one it was written with
cases.reason: 200,000 samples characterize JavaScript JSON formatting then assert same copied skeleton, without producing a different product oracle.

cases.title: is not loose: it is within a metadata field of what that costs
cases.reason: copied envelope slack comparison duplicates exact independently serialized shell reconstruction.

cases.title: `skips discarded mobile density work in ${mode ?? 'default'} view`
cases.reason: actual default/web outputs preserve native route and skip density/envelope work; remove redundant keys/stringified-output assertions after deep equality.

rationale: Retain concrete recorded Chromium coordinate behavior, zoom inversion, radius/scroll conversion and invalid input boundaries.

cases.title: maps the visual center of a letterboxed desktop frame to the browser center
cases.reason: Letterboxing maps visual center to expected source center.

cases.title: inverts pan and zoom around the rendered frame center
cases.reason: Forward screen projection is inverse of public map under nontrivial pan/zoom.

cases.title: maps a tap on a page with no viewport meta into the page CSS pixels
cases.reason: Recorded no-viewport-meta scale lands inside independently measured button bounds.

cases.title: divides the frame device space by the page scale and adds no scroll offset
cases.reason: Page scale converts device to CSS coordinates without adding scroll offset.

cases.title: leaves web view mode where it was, at a page scale of one
cases.reason: Unit page scale keeps existing desktop coordinates.

cases.title: reads a missing or unusable page scale as one rather than dividing by it
cases.reason: Invalid page scales fall back safely.

cases.title: grows the touch radius by the page scale, because a CSS pixel is smaller
cases.reason: Touch radius scales with actual CSS pixel size.

cases.title: scrolls the page by the page scale, not by the frame fit alone
cases.reason: Recorded phone scale converts screen flick into correct page scroll.

cases.title: leaves a web view scroll and a pinched one where they were
cases.reason: Unit/pinched scroll and absent geometry retain expected deltas.

cases.title: rejects page-level touch coordinates instead of mixing coordinate spaces
cases.reason: Page-level coordinates are rejected rather than silently mixing spaces.

cases.title: clamps zoom offsets after the viewport geometry changes
cases.reason: Viewport change bounds pan offsets without changing permitted zoom.

rationale: Retain public localhost/domain and file-address formatting behavior including Windows file URLs.

cases.title: keeps localhost-style addresses as http URLs
cases.reason: Local addresses use HTTP instead of interpreting port as scheme.

cases.title: adds https for regular domains without a scheme
cases.reason: Ordinary scheme-less domain uses HTTPS.

cases.title: shows the decoded filename for local and Windows-style file URLs
cases.reason: Native and Windows file URLs show decoded filename.

cases.title: does not compact ordinary or malformed URLs
cases.reason: Ordinary/malformed URL is not mislabeled as local file.

rationale: Retain focused/unfocused state transitions that protect edits while applying current remote URL.

cases.title: syncs the tab URL when the input is not focused
cases.reason: Unfocused changed remote URL synchronizes text.

cases.title: defers tab URL sync while the user is editing
cases.reason: Focus defers remote URL text overwrite.

cases.title: syncs the latest tab URL when editing ends
cases.reason: Blur applies latest URL even if URL itself is unchanged.

cases.title: preserves externally updated address text when focus and tab URL are unchanged
cases.reason: Unchanged focus/URL does not overwrite text produced by stream navigation.

rationale: Retain actual mounted stream disposal/recreation across background and batched foreground transitions.

cases.title: stops the stream in the background and starts a new one on return
cases.reason: Background disposes subscription and foreground starts exactly one replacement.

cases.title: starts a new stream when the leave and the return land in one render
cases.reason: Batched leave/return still changes visit generation and disposes original stream.

rationale: Fix host fake so confirm outcome derives from the actual emitted RPC method, not an explicit test-supplied accept boolean; retain dialog lifecycle/race cases.

cases.title: raises the second dialog and answers the confirm with OK
cases.reason: host now accepts/dismisses according to observed RPC method, so OK outcome detects a misrouted command; still verifies delayed close and sequential dialogs.

cases.title: keeps the card pressable and says so when the answer does not reach the page
cases.reason: Host rejection keeps dialog and visible error, then retry advances via real bridged request.

cases.title: kills the card buttons while an answer is in flight, so a double tap sends one
cases.reason: title now states actual disabled-button assertions rather than claiming a double tap that setup never performed.

cases.title: stamps the failure on the dialog that was answered, never on the one that replaced it
cases.reason: Deferred failure from retired dialog must not poison replacement dialog.

cases.title: answers the confirm with Cancel
cases.reason: Cancel result comes from actual browser.dialogDismiss method instead of explicit false supplied to fake; retains frame/visible-close behavior.

rationale: Retain ready-without-pixels and binary-grant behavior; consolidate redundant granted-stream positive control into real-pixels case.

cases.title: keeps showing the loading indicator instead of an empty black pane
cases.reason: Ready event without image bytes cannot clear loading indicator.

cases.title: clears the indicator once real pixels arrive
cases.reason: actual binary callback clears spinner and renders bytes; now also asserts no missing-grant error as positive control.

cases.title: never subscribes, and says so with the stream-error state it already has
cases.reason: Missing grant suppresses subscription and renders explicit upgrade guidance.

cases.title: subscribes when the shell names it, which is the control for the case above
cases.reason: real-pixels case already requires granted subscription; move no-upgrade-error assertion there instead of another identical mount.
